g.text: The address of the UpgradeableBeacons is stored in the factory
and used everytime new BeaconProxies are deployed.
Brickken is the admin of those UpgradeableBeacons, having
the power to upgrade the underlying implementation.
Brickken is also admin of BeaconProxies, however,
this adminship can be handed over to clients and
clients can decide to move away from the bacon implementation
